  3. Log in op /wp-admin en open Plugins, Thema’s, Instellingen, Media of WooCommerce — wat bij enumeration past.

This guide covers Block User enumeration. You work in WordPress (wp-admin), focusing on user, enumeration, blokkeren — not unrelated side quests in other menus.

Preparation

  • Focus of this article: user, enumeration, blokkeren
  • Recent backup or snapshot

Steps

  1. Start in WordPress (wp-admin). Before clicking, note the current value for user, enumeration, blokkeren.
  2. Take a backup (Installatron or panel) before changing user.
  3. Sign in to /wp-admin and open Plugins, Themes, Settings, Media or WooCommerce — whatever fits enumeration.
  4. Apply the change; on a critical error isolate via File Manager (rename plugins).
  5. Clear caches and test the pages that touch blokkeren.
  6. Rotate credentials tied to user, enumeration, blokkeren if abuse was possible.
  7. Schedule monitoring or a follow-up check.

Verify

  • Result for user, enumeration, blokkeren matches “Block User enumeration”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside user enumeration blokkeren
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get user, enumeration, blokkeren right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if user, enumeration, blokkeren touches login, DNS, mail or payments.
